verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's CLI documents creating releases, associating commits with a release (auto-discovered from git), and recording deployments. That covers tying releases and commits together. However, nothing in the evidence shows issues displaying the release they first appeared in, or any suspect-commit attribution. missing for 10: documented first-seen release shown on each issue, suspect-commit identification linking an issue to the likely causing commit, independent or hands-on corroboration of release/commit tracking.
